Name: Hex Warden

Lore: A swamp hag who wardens the fens from afar, snaring anything that strays too near with a barbed little curse.

Name: Hex Stalker
Description: A ranged skirmisher — shoots, falls back and shoots again, never letting a foe close the distance it keeps.
Lore: A swamp hag who never stays where she fired from, drifting through the reeds a step ahead of whatever is chasing her.

Name: Chronomancer
Description: A caster who fights the party's tempo instead of its health.
Lore: It does not hurry. It makes everyone else late.
Card: Charges [Temporal Drag]: the party loses [tempo] and every foe acts sooner. [Interrupt] the charge, [cleanse] Slowed or [out-haste] it. Rewinds once when badly hurt.

Name: Monster Tamer
Description: A beast handler who turns wild monsters to the party's side instead of killing them.
Lore: Grew up among the pack; every snarl is a word she understands.
Card: Wild monsters turn [Tamed] and fight for you.

Name: Harpy Raider
Description: A Murder runner spliced with black wings: it dives on the weakest hero, rakes it and is gone again.
Lore: The Murder: Street kids spliced with black wings, who fly contraband (and people) past Concord checkpoints. They never land for long.
Card: Swift [Flanker]: strikes, then darts a tile away. Its talons can [Slow] a hero, costing the party [tempo]. [Pincer] it before it lifts off, or [cleanse] the Slow.

Name: Harpy Shrieker
Description: A Murder lookout whose spliced throat shrieks a gale that drags runaways out of formation.
Lore: The Murder: Street kids spliced with black wings, who fly contraband (and people) past Concord checkpoints. They never land for long.
Card: Charges a [Gale Shriek] that blows heroes apart and breaks your [pincer] lines. [Interrupt] the charge or keep the party spread out. Hastens the harpy it backs as a [Supporter].

Name: Harpy Spotter
Description: A Murder smuggler rigged with signal jammers: it hangs back and snipes the party's casters.
Lore: The Murder: Street kids spliced with black wings, who fly contraband (and people) past Concord checkpoints. They never land for long.
Card: Hangs back and fires [shots] at your casters; its darts can [Silence]. It is frail up close: close in and [pincer] it.

Name: Void Sentinel
Description: A slow, plated guardian of smoke that fires beams of leaking aether down a line.
Lore: What forms where an Anchor leaks: smoke given a body around a cyan heart of stolen aether. It guards whatever stands nearest, and does not know why.
Card: Charges a [Void Beam] down a marked line that [Silences]: step off the line or [Interrupt] it. Its front is plated, so [pincer] it from the flanks. At half HP its core flares a [Ward].

Name: Lich
Description: A deathless captain who rains soulfire from behind his crew, drains the party when cornered, and leaves a grave that raises him again.
Lore: The last captain of the Ark Long Patience. When his ship came down he refused to let it die, and kept himself instead.
Card: Charges [Soulfire] on a 3×3 that [Burns]: spread out or [Interrupt] it. At half HP it harvests every hero to heal. It falls into a grave: smash the grave, or it rises again.
